project_metadata.vibe: Ultra-premium, high-performance futuristic SaaS. Apple-level smoothness meets Tesla/Linear UI.

typography.rules: BANNED LIST: Inter, Roboto, Open Sans. NEVER use these.

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing (2-3x normal). Use p-8, p-12 in containers.
layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: The 'Tetris' Grid. gap-8 to gap-12. Asymmetry. col-span-full for hero.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: The 'Control Room' Grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-6. Dense data, crisp edges.
layout_and_spacing.alignment: Optical alignment. Left-align dense text/forms. Center-align hero if balanced.

surface_strategies.navbar: Glassmorphism: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/20.
surface_strategies.hero_overlay: Gradient overlay over 3D background to ensure text contrast: bg-gradient-to-b from-white/90 via-white/50 to-transparent.
surface_strategies.event_cards: Glassmorphism 'Crystal' variant on hover. Tracing Beam (animated gradient border mask) for 'Premium/Featured' events.

motion_and_interactions.principles: Apple-level smoothness. 60+ FPS. No jank. Tesla/Linear inspired.
motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Cards: -translate-y-1, scale-105 for images, subtle glow shadow increase. Text color explicitly set on hover.
motion_and_interactions.entrance: Staggered fade-up using Framer Motion (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1, duration: 0.5).
motion_and_interactions.3d_elements: Use React Three Fiber (R3F) for floating geometry (low-poly futuristic cubes, rings, glass panels) in the hero and 3D Experience sections. Apply Drei's <Float>.

components_strategy.marketing: Pure HTML/Tailwind for overlapping/asymmetry. Framer Motion for scroll/parallax.
components_strategy.dashboards: Shadcn UI (Tables, Tabs, Forms). Override defaults: h-auto on tabs, generous padding.
components_strategy.forms: Shadcn Input/Select. Floating labels or clean overlines.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='hero-explore-button').

media_urls.rules: NEVER use placeholders. Use only these URLs.

hero_3d_background.description: Abstract 3D glass geometry, floating spheres and cubes, light mode with cyan/purple rim lights. Use as the Hero section background image.

event_ticket_premium.description: Futuristic VIP event ticket with holographic elements. Use in the 3D Experience Section or Dashboard tickets overview.

past_events_gallery_1.description: Concert crowd daytime. Use in the past events masonry gallery.

past_events_gallery_2.description: Crowd hands in the air. Use in the past events masonry gallery.

upcoming_event_1.description: Modern interior grand staircase. Use for a premium upcoming corporate event card.

upcoming_event_2.description: Modern conference room. Use for an upcoming tech summit event card.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize optical clarity and Apple-level smoothness.
Setup Tailwind config carefully for the custom colors (#5B8CFF, #7B61FF, #00C2FF) and fonts.
Add font imports to index.css or index.html immediately.
Ensure all backgrounds are explicitly set. DO NOT use entirely transparent surfaces in floating cards.

Implement R3F (React Three Fiber) in the '3D Experience Section'. Use floating geometry (cubes, spheres, rings) with Drei's <Float> and <MeshTransmissionMaterial> for a glass look. Rim light them with cyan and blue.
For the Past Events masonry gallery, ensure hover states trigger a slight scale-up and subtle cyan glow via Box Shadow.
Upcoming event cards must have tilt (using Framer Motion or react-parallax-tilt), gradient borders, glow, countdown timer, and a register CTA.
Dashboards (User & Admin) should utilize a 'Bento' grid layout with generous gap-6 spacing and crisp borders.
Use standard .js and .jsx extensions for React files, NOT .tsx.
Ensure the hero has a mouse spotlight effect (radial gradient following cursor) and dynamic gradient lighting.
